Package com.csse3200.game.components.player

Class PlayerAbilitiesComponent

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.components.Component
com.csse3200.game.components.player.PlayerAbilitiesComponent
public class PlayerAbilitiesComponent extends Component
Hosts the player's abilities and owns only what every ability shares: cooldowns, the alive and unlock gating, and the abilityUsed, abilityEnded and abilityFailed events. Active lifetimes belong to the status effects controller, and everything specific to one ability belongs to its PlayerAbility subclass, so adding an ability is a registration rather than a change here.
